text:
Priya (CS): @Sophie thanks — we got your intake for the Orion Insurance custom summarizer. Quick clarifying q: will the training data include PHI (SSNs, med records)?
Sophie (Orion): Yes, there will be claim narratives with PHI and policy numbers. Need private deployment + KMS.
Priya (CS): noted. We'll flag for Private deployment + HSM option. @Liam can you scope Dedicated vs Private cost delta?
Liam - Solutions Eng: I'm on it. Two follow-ups: expected QPS and 99th p latency target?
Sophie (Orion): Peak 40 req/s, 99th ≤ 300ms for summaries, avg payload ~ 1.2k tokens.
Evan - ML Ops: 300ms 99th with private on prem is tight for 1.2k tokens — need batching/kv-caching + 8xA100 equiv. We'll propose tuned quant + prefix cache. Also: data residency EU required?
Sophie (Orion): EU region only, Austria & Germany offices.
Nate - Safety: For PHI we need PII redaction + model-level safety evals. Requesting an eval harness and adversarial prompt set. Also require audit logs without token storage. @Priya can you confirm retention window?
Priya (CS): Standard is 30d, but enterprise can set 0d (no token retention). I'll request 0d for Orion and add audit-only logs with metadata. Documenting in intake ticket.
deploy-bot: intake-form-submitted: /intakes/ORD-9823 — severity: high — attachments: spec.pdf
Liam - Solutions Eng: Sending draft infra estimate by EOD. Considering Private VPC + on-prem connector for Austria datacenter. Also include canary plan for rollouts.
Sophie (Orion): Can we run a safety eval on a 7B first? We want quality baseline before committing to bigger models for cost reasons.
Nate - Safety: We'll run safety + hallucination suite on 7B, plus a rerank/regression check against your golden set. Please upload golden set to the secure intake link.
Sophie (Orion): Uploading now. Also question re: SLA and renewal: if performance holds, we'll likely convert to annual reserved capacity after POC.
Priya (CS): Great — noting renewal intent. We'll treat this as high-touch onboarding and assign a renewal playbook after POC. Capturing blocker: PHI + EU-only + 300ms 99th.
Evan - ML Ops: One more ops note: for EU-only private with 0d tokens, tracing is limited. We'll provide span-level traces but no token payloads.
Sophie (Orion): That works. Any ETA on the eval run?
Nate - Safety: Starting eval tomorrow; expect first results in 72 hours. Will post summary + failure cases to thread.
Priya (CS): I'll open a shared confluence with onboarding checklist and connect you with our success engineer. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sophie (Orion): Thanks everyone :pray:
